meta.name: La Ley y el Orden Toronto: Intento Criminal
meta.description: An elite squad of detectives investigate high-profile crime and corruption in metro Toronto.
meta.country: Canada, United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: The Key to the Castle
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the disappearance of a crypto investor when he vanishes on Lake Ontario, along with hundreds of millions of his clients' dollars.

videos.title: Good Neighbours
videos.overview: A shooting at a condo building leads Graff and Bateman to a twenty-year-old cold case that they must solve in order to catch the killer.

videos.title: The Real Eve
videos.overview: When a beloved art professor, Eve Kinwood, is killed, the team must use her art to find the Real Eve and her killer.

videos.title: Crack Reporter
videos.overview: A stabbing on a crowded transit walkway throws the detectives into the middle of a heated mayoral race as they investigate the murder of a local journalist.

videos.title: Bleeding Heart
videos.overview: When a murder leads Graff and Bateman to a global crime syndicate, they must weave through a complex maze of criminals and victims to find the killer.

videos.title: Minnow and the Shark
videos.overview: The death of an executive at a major grocery chain sends our detectives into the cutthroat business of selling food and corporate corruption.

videos.title: The Sound of Silence
videos.overview: The discovery of a young woman's remains leads our detectives to the toxic workplace from which she was wrongfully dismissed.

videos.title: Boys Will Be Boys
videos.overview: When a local hockey star is found dead on the ice, Graff and Bateman must untangle a hazing scandal that led to the player's suspension days before his death.

videos.title: Three Points
videos.overview: The death of a prominent rapper-turned-producer sends Graff and Bateman on the tail of a frenzied serial killer at large in the city.

videos.title: Cul-de-Sac
videos.overview: The neighbours of a respected defence attorney become the prime suspects in her murder.

videos.title: White Squirrel City
videos.overview: When an unhoused man is stabbed to death in a downtown park, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate as attention turns to his various neighbours.

videos.title: Digital Lipstick
videos.overview: A stabbing in the PATH leads Graff and Bateman to one of the most scandalous data breaches in Toronto's history.

videos.title: Fool's Gold
videos.overview: When an airport worker is found dead of an apparent suicide, Graff and Bateman quickly deduce he has been murdered and may be responsible for a crime of his own.

videos.title: Hoggs Hollow
videos.overview: The team is called to investigate when a young wife is killed in her Hoggs Hollow home, and they uncover a secret hidden within the home and the police department.

videos.title: Face Value
videos.overview: A well-liked couple is murdered at their place of business, and while all clues point to a robbery, Graff and Bateman soon discover the murder was a targeted hit.

videos.title: Disposable People
videos.overview: The death of a prison inmate takes Graff and Bateman to a maximum-security detention centre to investigate.

videos.title: The Man in the Stadium
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman are called into the Rogers Centre when a famous Canadian stand-up comic drops dead during a rehearsal on stage.

videos.title: Canadian Dream
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate when a prominent tech CEO is shot to death in a parking lot alongside an unlucky young delivery driver who happened to be cycling by.

videos.title: Bitter Pill
videos.overview: When a billionaire pharmaceutical CEO and his philanthropist wife are found dead in their home, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate.

videos.title: Tango Romeo
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a seemingly unremarkable middle-aged travel agent when he is found dead outside his split-level house in Mimico.

videos.title: Skin Deep
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman are called to investigate when an aspiring model is found dead in a landfill during Toronto's Fashion Week.

videos.title: WAGMI
videos.overview: When a body is found hanging in a tree, Graff and Bateman are called to investigate the death of a reclusive math tutor.

videos.title: Uncertain Justice
videos.overview: The team is brought in to investigate when a mother convicted of infanticide is found dead in a motel bathroom after being released on an appeal.

videos.title: Forget Me Not
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman are called to investigate, when a beloved resident at a retirement home is found dead of exposure, frozen to death in a nearby park.

videos.title: Up To Snuff
videos.overview: When a genuine snuff film is aired at a local film festival, Graff and Bateman are asked to investigate.

videos.title: Family Meal
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a high-flying corporate consultant, who lives for facts and numbers.

videos.title: Whole Lotta Love
videos.overview: When a promising student is found stabbed to death on her university campus, Graff and Bateman are called in to investigate her murder.

videos.title: The Winning Bid
videos.overview: A stabbing at a skatepark sends Graff and Bateman into the intricate web of Toronto real estate scams.

videos.title: Lost & Unfound
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman are called in to investigate when the body of a handyman is found on a Rosedale walking trail.

videos.title: XOXO
videos.overview: Graff and Bateman investigate the death of a beloved politician with a troubled past.

videos.title: Diplomatico
videos.overview: When a College Street shooting points to a mob war, Bateman is partnered with Guns & Gangs detective John Darcy to work the case.

videos.title: The Scorpion and the Tortoise
videos.overview: Darcy and Bateman are called to investigate body parts discovered in packages at a mail facility, leading them to a chilling suspect adept at weaving through legal loopholes.

videos.title: The Business of Boys
videos.overview: Darcy and Bateman are pulled into the emotionally charged world of high school gender politics and the manosphere, when a beloved but burnt-out teacher is killed.

videos.title: True Patriot Love
videos.overview: Darcy and Bateman investigate a John Doe found dead in an alley, leading them to uncover the truth behind a decades-old murder of a Canadian soldier in Afghanistan.

videos.title: Bad Campers
videos.overview: When the co-founder of a heritage clothing brand is murdered in his secret loft, Darcy and Bateman must peel back the curated brand image to find his killer.

videos.title: Wind Phone
videos.overview: When the head of ethics at an AI start-up is killed before he can become a whistleblower, Darcy and Bateman must zero in on who had the most to lose.

videos.title: Fireworks
videos.overview: A firefighter's wife is found dead in her burnt-out home. Darcy and Bateman piece together what really happened, in order to bring her killer to justice in court.

videos.title: Family Tree
videos.overview: Darcy and Bateman are called to investigate the death of a man looking into mysteries around his birth leading the detectives into the secretive world of fertility clinics.

videos.title: Canary
videos.overview: When a seemingly random shooting at a shopping centre leaves a university student dead, Darcy and Bateman must unravel her complicated past to find her killer.

videos.title: Red Flags
videos.overview: Darcy and Bateman investigate the death of an inmate in prison, uncovering the drug scheme he was about to expose - and the corruption within their own ranks making it work.
